verdict.rationale: Gmail's help docs mention Gemini can 'delete multiple emails or add labels' (gmail-docs-14) and general email organization/filtering features (gmail-docs-18, gmail-docs-15), which implies some bulk-action capability, but the evidence never documents the classic power-user workflow of selecting many conversations via checkboxes and archiving/labeling/marking done in one click. Missing for 10: direct documentation of multi-select checkbox UI, one-click bulk archive/label/mark-done actions, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow.
